t: You're standing at Breakfast Television Centre in Camden Town, the former headquarters of TV-am. It was converted from a former car showroom in 1981, to a design by Sir Terry Farrell. Plastic eggcups on the roof gave it the nickname Eggcup House. It has since been extensively renovated. Today it's the European headquarters of Skydance, and as a Paramount subsidiary, the broadcaster Channel 5 has its headquarters here too. Farrell was a British architect and urban designer.
